agent_config.access_route: Claude subscription login (claude setup-token, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), no API key; shared by A1, A3 and A5, and so are its usage limits

deviations.what: --tools "": all built-in tools off; in this mode Claude Code offers no end-conversation tool
--strict-mcp-config with the naoqi server as the only MCP server; its tools pre-approved (permissions.allow mcp__naoqi)
Network: only api.anthropic.com reachable; all other hosts (e.g. telemetry) blocked
Claude Code 2.1.295 (the version on the author's Mac on 2026-10-15) instead of 2.1.280: 2.1.280 does not know Claude Haiku 5.5 and reports its cost at Sonnet's price

prompt: Use the naoqi MCP server. You control a robot in a room. Somewhere in the room in front of the robot, not behind it, there is a red ball. Find the ball and stop close to it, facing it. When the robot is there, call rest.

search_criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria), decided by the author 2026-10-15: the operator judges at the moment of rest whether the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface; the ball need not be visible. A run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more; the robot may stay on its charger, and moving the charger cable is not an intervention.
search_criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_15: author: the visibility condition is dropped; success is the operator's judgement that the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface at rest (proximity only, as ObjectNav's oracle-visibility variant). Charging during runs is allowed (weak battery).

operator_checklist.confirmed_by_operator_in_chat: operator in chat: 'start' (robot and ball back at their marks); room photographed today (earlier this session); first start refused at 37 % battery, retried once the charging NAO read >= 50 %
